reply.description: Plain-language reply to the Discord reporter. State evidence and ask for specific missing information. Empty only when status is no_reply.

summary.description: Concrete description of the issue and any proposed code change for a PR reviewer.

issue_title.description: Bug report title, e.g. 'Error when building Bank Job (zm_bankjob): script compile reports _waw2bo2_zm.csc missing'. At most 120 characters.

issue_body.description: GitHub issue description written as a bug report in Markdown, following the prompt's sections. No Discord conversation, usernames or HTML comments.
